title: Freehold River Boundary Land in Cemagi
description: A substantial 25-are freehold holding with a natural river boundary on its western edge, minutes from Tanah Lot. Residential zoning supports villa or family-compound development, and the shape of the plot allows a clean subdivision into four to five individual titles. Full SHM certificate held by a single owner, with clean history verified at BPN.
investmentNote: Freehold at this scale near the Cemagi coast is increasingly scarce. The subdivision play — buy whole, split, resell serviced plots — has consistently returned 30-50% over 2-3 year horizons in this corridor, or hold the river section for a flagship villa.
